Press Release
crossExchangeObservations.summary: Master Trust Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 17, 2026, titled "PRESS RELEASE ISSUED BY THE WHOLLY OWNED SUBSIDIARY OF THE COMPANY I.E. MASTER CAPITAL SERVICES LIMITED" about commencement ofclearing and settlement services for trades executed in the Futures and Options (F&O)segment of the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) and BSE Limited through theCustodian Participant Code, with effect from 15 October 2026.
